title: Senior Product Manager, FoodStorm
searchText: Senior Product Manager, FoodStorm Instacart We're transforming the grocery industry At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. Instacart is a Flex First team There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. Overview FoodStorm, part of Instacart, powers prepared-foods operations for major retailers. As a Senior Product Manager, reporting to the General Manager of FoodStorm, you will own a critical product domain within FoodStorm’s Order Management Platform, driving product strategy and execution that enables retailers to scale their operations - in store and online. Your work will directly influence how enterprise partners manage orders, production, fulfillment, and integrations and how customers experience the grocery store of the future. You will join a small, high‑impact R&D team operating like a scale‑up and collaborate with a much larger Product team as part of a publicly listed Silicon Valley tech company. This role requires strong product leadership, sharp commercial thinking, clear communication, and the ability to partner closely with Engineering, Design, DS, Professional Services, and other Instacart Product teams to deliver measurable customer and business impact. Combining the culture of a scale-up with the benefits and influence of a Silicon Valley tech giant, FoodStorm provides a unique opportunity to join our small, growing R&D team based in Australia, while collaborating with a large, highly proficient team around the world. The role offers full-time remote work within Australia or access to our Melbourne office, competitive salary, and additional employee benefits. About the Job Own a critical product area end-to-end, from discovery through delivery and iteration, ensuring clear commercial and customer outcomes are defined and achieved. Translate customer needs and business objectives into clear product strategy, well-defined roadmaps, and focused execution plans grounded in data and measurable impact. Work extensively with our retail partners to scope and test features, observe user behaviors, and iterate quickly; support pilots and launches as needed to drive strong adoption and value realization. Lead the entire product lifecycle, from deep user and retailer discovery to final delivery. Use qualitative and quantitative research, retailer feedback, and industry best practices to identify new opportunities. Intake, validate, and convert new ideas into implementable projects with clear success metrics, and PRDs/specifications. Champion best-in-class design and user experiences by applying strong product craft and design thinking principles. Drive cross‑functional alignment by partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science and Operations teams to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions; communicate tradeoffs, risks, and progress with transparency and urgency. About You Minimum Qualifications You have 4+ years of Product Management experience, ideally within complex web-based or enterprise B2B software environments. You’ve driven product or technical innovation from 0-1 and know how to turn early signals into scalable solutions. You’re highly data-literate and comfortable working with complex analytics to guide decisions in ambiguous situations. You communicate complex ideas with clarity and influence, aligning cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders around shared goals without direct authority. You operate with an entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable in fast-moving, evolving environments while maintaining high standards. You care deeply about building great software and strong teams — and you hold yourself accountable to meaningful customer and commercial outcomes. Preferred Qualifications Your leadership style is grounded in trust, clarity, and empowerment. You raise the bar for those around you. Strong ability to navigate both a startup‑like environment and Instacart‑scale operations A passion for building great teams and great software that delivers measurable impact for customers and the business. We're transforming the grocery industry At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more...
